title: Putting generative AI to work — safely
excerpt: A pragmatic framework for scaling GenAI from pilots to production value.
body: Most generative-AI programs stall somewhere between an impressive pilot and dependable production value. The gap is rarely the model — it's the operating discipline around it.

The approach that works: tie every use case to a business metric, ground models in your own data, and put guardrails and human review where the risk actually lives. Small, instrumented releases beat big-bang launches every time.
Done this way, AI compounds — each shipped use case builds the data, the patterns and the confidence that make the next one faster.

title: The modern platform advantage
excerpt: Why cloud-native operating models decide who leads their category.
body: Cloud stopped being an infrastructure decision a long time ago — it's an operating model. The companies that lead their categories ship faster because their platforms make the safe path the easy path.
That means cloud-native architecture, automated delivery pipelines, and platform teams that treat internal developers as customers. Resilience and cost-efficiency follow from the same design choices.
The payoff is momentum: ideas reach production in days instead of quarters, and the platform gets stronger with every release.

title: Closing critical roles, faster
excerpt: How disciplined search closes even niche positions within the first five profiles.
body: Critical roles stay open when search is treated as a volume game. Disciplined search starts by understanding the context and culture a candidate will actually work in.
That's why our benchmark is closing positions within the first five profiles — even for niche, hard-to-fill requirements. Fewer, better-matched candidates move faster through every stage.
It shows after the hire too: better matches stay. That's how a 95%+ placement retention rate gets built.
